==About me==
The first time I saw The Wheel Of Time was when I was 21 years old and walking in our local book market, I remember seeing the cover of THE SHADOW RISES and was like:"huh, bad cover and this seems a not-so-interesting novel,besides, I don't have the first novel so how can I keep up?" and moved on.

Next week, my brother went alone to the same book market and as I asked him to bring me a fantasy novel, he mistakengling brought me "THE GREAT HUNT" and again, aweful cover made me put it aside and forgot it even exsisted.



Days passed and my visits to the market became more frequent, and I began to see bits and pieces of the novels (Book 8, 7 ,5 and 2 mostly)  and so I bought them and googled them but as long I don't have the first novel of the series, I never picked them up.



Then came a day, almost six months after the first time I saw the first wheel of time book that accidentaly, I saw the EYE OF THE WORLD (Hard Cover) with a price of 1$ and I bought i.then returned home, and thus started my fascination with the world of WHEEL OF TIME.



I devoured the pages, page after page after page, waking up with the book beside me to continue what I couldn't read the previous night and hardly eating to have time to read more, I became obsessed with the series and began searching for it but couldn't find any aside from books (2,4,5, 7 and 8). So I downloaded the audiobooks and that was probably the most amazing three months of my life,I was transfered to another world,and fell in love with the characters so much that I wish I was there fighting with them, the settings, the battles and most amazing sence (imho) was the cleansing of Saiden....



And now i wait,for the 14th book to come out, when four years ago, I never knew it even exsisted 



The day I discovered this series  was indeed, MY LUCKY DAY [[User:FiF|FiF]] ([[User talk:FiF|talk]]) 07:43, July 21, 2012 (UTC)
